frozen_scientific_scope.taxon: Radiolites dario (Catullo), printed darìo by Cestari2005
frozen_scientific_scope.primary_specimen: Cestari2005 Plate2 Fig1 right-hand individual, La Sapienza University collection; individual catalog number not given
frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Same-species interpretation: lower valve based on the smaller right-hand R.dario specimen in Plate2 Fig1; low flat lid reconstructed from the same paper species description. The photographed specimen does not establish preserved upper valve. No other rudist species combined.

scale.basis: Caption gives base width7cm for the whole Fig1 panel. Smaller right specimen about43-45mm tall and25-28mm wide based on panel scaling. Depth is an inference, not measured; use45x25x23mm working dimensions including thin restored lid.
scale.uncertainty: Partial fossil and oblique photo: rounded estimates, not exact specimen measurement or scan. No claim of missing basal length.

simplifications: Upper valve not confirmed preserved in photograph; restored shape supported only by same-species published description.
Hidden inner shell cells, ligament/hinge and microscopic structure omitted; no unsupported open interior.
Neutral muted stone palette artistic; no original life-color claim and no paper image as texture.
